automation_scripts_rules.description: For test cases of this type, all implicit and supporting steps must be implemented in automation, even if not explicitly listed in the manual test steps. This ensures the test case's purpose and execution requirements are fully validated.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All implicit and supporting steps for test case type C51 (Add Shortcuts)
rule_definition: WHEN: Automating any test case of type C51 (Add Shortcuts) or similar cases where implicit/supporting steps are present in the correlation mapping.

THEN: You MUST include every implicit step labeled as 'Required for Test Execution' and every supporting step labeled as 'Purpose of Test Case Validation', even if not present in the original manual test steps.

IMPLEMENTATION: For each such step, implement the mapped script line and follow all intermediary steps in the exact order provided. Do not skip, merge, or reorder steps. For example: Reset the app to initial state → self.fc.reset_app() (Launch the app, Navigate to settings, Select reset option, Confirm reset), and so on for each step in the mapping.

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-one mapping rule for direct test step to script line automation.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test steps where a single test step maps to a single script line.
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step directly maps to a single automation script line in the correlation.
THEN: Implement the automation using the mapped script line and follow all intermediary steps for that mapping.
IMPLEMENTATION: For each such test step, use the mapped script line and execute all intermediary steps in the specified order.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Rule for implicit/purpose-based supporting steps required for test case validation.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All implicit steps labeled as required for test execution or purpose validation, even if not present in manual test steps.
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases of type 'Verify the screen when the user enables only the 'Save' destination in the 'Add Shortcut' screen.' and an implicit/supporting step is present in the correlation.
THEN: You MUST include the implicit/supporting step, its mapped script line(s), and intermediary steps, even if not explicitly mentioned in the manual test steps.

IMPLEMENTATION: For each implicit/supporting step (e.g., 'Add the printer device', 'Verify shortcuts screen is displayed', 'Verify add new shortcut screen is displayed', 'Verify add new shortcut title is displayed'), implement the mapped script lines and intermediary steps in the exact order as shown in the correlation and intermediary_steps arrays. This ensures the test case's purpose is validated and no required logic is skipped.
